say:2:1422016001:0.text: What did you guys say to Lavas?
say:2:1422016001:0.source_cn: 你们跟拉瓦斯说什么啦？

say:3:1422016002:0.text: What happened? He didn't do anything drastic, did he?
say:3:1422016002:0.source_cn: 怎么了？他不会想不开出什么事了吧？！

say:4:1422016003:1.text: Nothing like that. Yesterday, he came back all excited, clutching his Furnace Brewer and rambling on about how the machine was the true brewmaster...
say:4:1422016003:1.source_cn: 没有没有，他昨天兴冲冲地回来，抱着他的酿造器一个劲地跟...

say:5:1422016004:0.text: He headed out early this morning with the machine, saying he was going to tap into the home brewing market and promote his machine everywhere!
say:5:1422016004:0.source_cn: 今天一早他就带着他的酿造器走啦，说他要开拓什么家用酿造...

say:6:1422016005:0.text: Did I have one too many Flamefern Brew? Why couldn't I understand a word he said?
say:6:1422016005:0.source_cn: 我不会是火鳞酿喝多了吧……怎么一句话都听不懂呢？

say:7:1422016006:0.text: You'll get it soon enough—when you start having beer made with Lavas' Furnace Brewer at every party you go to!
say:7:1422016006:0.source_cn: 很快你就会懂啦！说不定过不了多久，你在宴会上喝到的啤酒...
